_about: What a rules provider is asked, and what each answer must be (contract/rules/v1/protocol.md). `arrange` runs in order on a fresh fixture: `place` renders and places every file by the contract's rules; `edit` changes the first file of a placement, inside its provider region or outside it; `delete` removes the first instructions file; `note` changes the fixture's first note. `target` in `expect` is the file an `edit` or `delete` touched.

cases.name: render answers with the schema
cases.why: one JSON answer on stdout, every path safe, at least one instructions file

cases.name: render reads no environment
cases.why: two machines render the same bytes from the same commit

cases.name: every note is in every instructions file
cases.why: the tenant's own rules reach every IDE's agent

cases.name: a hand-written file is not taken whole
cases.why: a tenant's own text is never overwritten

cases.name: a change inside a block is drift
the tenant's text outside a block is not drift
a change to a whole file is drift
a deleted file is absent, not drift
a changed note is drift
cases.why: the declaration is an input, so changing it without re-rendering is caught

cases.name: an unknown verb gets no answer
cases.why: a caller then fails closed rather than read a guess
